# What interest rate is really inside your car lease quote?

> Free car lease calculator. Turn a money factor into APR, find the money factor hiding in a quoted payment, price dealer markup in dollars, and compare leasing with buying. Private, in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [What is a money factor? Lease APR explained, with an example](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/car-lease-deal-checker/what-is-a-money-factor.html)
